Trio Mix-Assistant [SIMULATION] -> https://0.0.0.0:8770/
  [!] No PIN: anyone on this network can open the dashboard and control the
      console. On shared WiFi set one (--pin, or PIN= in show.conf).
  Trusted TLS — do this ONCE per device for ZERO warnings:
    1) Get the root CA onto the device — copy / AirDrop / email this file:
         <app>\.certs\ca.pem
    2) Install + TRUST it:
         iOS:     install the profile, then Settings > General > About > Certificate Trust Settings > enable it
         Android: Settings > Security > Install a certificate > CA certificate
         macOS:   double-click > Keychain 'System' > set this cert to 'Always Trust'
         Windows: double-click > Install > Local Machine > 'Trusted Root Certification Authorities'
    3) Reload  https://127.0.0.1:8770/  — trusted, no warning.
Press Ctrl+C to stop.
